plan_a:
Red burn: the plan is simple and fast — point every burn spell (Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, Rift Bolt, Fireblast) at the opponent's FACE and deploy one-drops (Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear, Eidolon of the Great Revel) for extra reach. Price of Progress punishes nonbasics. Only kill their creatures if you'd otherwise die. Count lethal every turn; you usually win by turn 4 — race, don't durdle.
YOUR DECKLIST (you know your own deck's contents; only the draw order is hidden): 2x Arid Mesa, 2x Bloodstained Mire, 4x Chain Lightning, 4x Eidolon of the Great Revel, 4x Fireblast, 4x Goblin Guide, 4x Lava Spike, 4x Lightning Bolt, 4x Monastery Swiftspear, 16x Mountain, 4x Price of Progress, 4x Rift Bolt, 2x Searing Blaze, 2x Sunbaked Canyon
YOUR CARDS (what each card in your deck does):
  Arid Mesa no cost — {T}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice Arid Mesa: Search your library for a Mountain or Plains card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
  Bloodstained Mire no cost — {T}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice Bloodstained Mire: Search your library for a Swamp or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
  Chain Lightning {R} — Chain Lightning deals 3 damage to any target. Then that player or that permanent's controller may pay {R}{R}. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.
  Eidolon of the Great Revel {R}{R} — Whenever a player casts a spell with mana value 3 or less, Eidolon of the Great Revel deals 2 damage to that player.
  Fireblast {4}{R}{R} — You may sacrifice two Mountains rather than pay this spell's mana cost.\nFireblast deals 4 damage to any target.
  Goblin Guide {R} — Haste\nWhenever Goblin Guide attacks, defending player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a land card, that player puts it into their hand.
  Lava Spike {R} — Lava Spike deals 3 damage to target player or planeswalker.
  Lightning Bolt {R} — Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
  Monastery Swiftspear {R} — Haste\nProwess (Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
  Mountain no cost — ({T}: Add {R}.)
  Price of Progress {1}{R} — Price of Progress deals damage to each player equal to twice the number of nonbasic lands that player controls.
  Rift Bolt {2}{R} — Rift Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.\nSuspend 1—{R} (Rather than cast this card from your hand, you may pay {R} and exile it with a time counter on it. At the beginning of your upkeep, remove a time counter. When the last is removed, you may cast it without paying its mana cost.)
  Searing Blaze {R}{R} — Searing Blaze deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and 1 damage to target creature that player or that planeswalker's controller controls.\nLandfall — If you had a land enter the battlefield under your control this turn, Searing Blaze deals 3 damage to that player or planeswalker and 3 damage to that creature instead.
  Sunbaked Canyon no cost — {T}, Pay 1 life: Add {R} or {W}.\n{1}, {T}, Sacrifice Sunbaked Canyon: Draw a card.
